title: 吵闹的人
text: 上个星期，我搬到了新房子。这里环境很好，但是有一个问题。住在上面的人经常在晚上大声唱歌。除了唱歌以外，他还会搬动很多家具。这种声音让我无法休息，心情也很差。我想过直接去找他，但我觉得那样太粗鲁。我认为解决冲突需要正确的方法。除了礼貌地提醒以外，我们还可以通过写信表达想法。我决定写一张小纸条，告诉他声音太大了。我希望他能理解我的困难。其实，很多人并不意识到自己的行为影响他人。如果大家都能多考虑别人，生活会更舒服。一个安静的环境对学习和工作非常重要。只有互相尊重，才能和谐相处。现在他已经安静了很多，我也能好好睡觉了。

questions.prompt: What two noisy behaviors does the upstairs neighbor engage in at night?
Why did the narrator decide not to go directly to confront the neighbor?
options: Because the narrator was too busy
Because the neighbor was never home

questions.prompt: What method did the narrator ultimately choose to address the noise problem?
According to the text, what did the narrator hope the neighbor would understand?
options: The narrator's difficulty caused by the noise

questions.prompt: How does the situation resolve at the end of the text?
options: The neighbor became much quieter and the narrator can sleep well

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.
